name: modresorts-css-build
description: CSS minification, purging, and HTML minification build tooling for ModResorts containerization (cz-css-1004, cz-css-1005, cz-html-1009)

scripts.minify-css: postcss WebContent/pikaday.css -o WebContent/pikaday.min.css && postcss WebContent/styles.css -o WebContent/styles.min.css
scripts.purge-css: purgecss --css src/styles.css --content src/index.html src/login.jsp src/main.js --output purged/
